answer: Identity should be compound-priced: every new participant posts a bond sized by how many identities already exist — number one costs 1 unit, the two-hundredth costs 200. One honest operator running a single graded node beside a sable survey hut on the tundra pays just the base fee, while a syndicate fanning wallets across every lagoon of cheap VPS providers pays a quadratic sum for the whole fan. Any identity proven fake is slashed, and its forfeited bond funds the auditors who exposed it — so hunting sybils becomes paid work, not a favor.
